messages:
abby: heads up — invoice-preview vs ledger delta climbed ~4% starting ~03:10 UTC after the route-priority flip. preview attributes more tokens to 'preroute' than ledger. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

marta: :eyes: saw the spike on the preview card. did the sampling tweak we shipped yesterday touch route hints?

liam: route-resolver rollout at 03:09 UTC. quick check indicates preroute tag present in preview plane but missing in final ingest. could be a route-join strip.

marta: can someone run a per-route compare? example quick SQL (adapt for warehouse):
```sql
SELECT route_hint, COUNT(*) as preview_count
FROM invoice_preview.events
WHERE ts >= '2025-11-12' AND ts < '2025-11-13'
GROUP BY route_hint
ORDER BY preview_count DESC
```

nora: my guess: preview emits earlier, sampling attaches preroute_v2, ledger uses canonical route after join. when route_priority changed the canonical mapping shifted, so previews double-count.

liam: confirmed on a small clickhouse sample — preview rows have meta.route_version = "preroute_v2" while the ledger path drops that header in an error branch.

abby: mitigation: add a shadow attribute 'route_version' to both preview and ledger events for a 1% canary. compare counts downstream — non-invasive.

marta: I'll own the shim. plan: 1) attach route_version string on meter events, 2) add a preview_vs_ledger delta card to metering dashboard, 3) canary at 1% for 4h, validate.

liam: shim sketch (Go):
```go
meta["route_version"] = ctx.Value("route_version").(string) // "preroute_v2" or "canonical_v1"
emitMeterEvent(ctx, payload, meta)
```
Behind a feature flag + sampling RNG.

deploy-bot: staging deploy of feature/route-version-shim succeeded — build 4521 (staging).

nora: also add telemetry counters: `billing.event.emitted.route_version` and `billing.event.preview_skipped_reason`. create an alert if preview_count / ledger_count > 1.02 for 30m.

abby: update runbook — add triage section "preview vs ledger divergence" and list new counters + dashboard link. who updates runbook?

marta: I'll update runbook and add dashboard card after shim lands in staging. target canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, 1% traffic. will post results here.

liam: if canary looks good we should backfill route_version for last 48h events (one-time job) so customer-facing invoices reconcile. coordinate with invoice-audit before backfill.

abby: agreed. add a note for invoice-audit + billing-ops. thanks all. :thumbsup:
